_comment_id: Sequential ID like PPC-0013. Use the next available number.
_comment_title: Descriptive title, e.g., 'Brihadeeswarar Temple – Permanent Pictorial Cancellation'
_comment_postOffice: Full name of the post office, e.g., 'Thanjavur Head Post Office'
_comment_pinCode: 6-digit PIN code of the post office
_comment_subject: Subject or full description of the PPC design
_comment_inaugurationDate: Date the PPC was inaugurated, in YYYY-MM-DD format, e.g., '2023-04-05'
_comment_requested: true if you have sent a request to the post office, false otherwise
_comment_requestedDate: Date you sent the request, in YYYY-MM-DD format. Leave empty string if not requested.
_comment_received: true if you have received the PPC, false otherwise
_comment_receivedDate: Date you received the PPC, in YYYY-MM-DD format. Leave empty string if not received.
_comment_trackingNumber: Postal tracking number if available, e.g., 'EM123456789IN'. Leave empty if none.
_comment_requestMethod: How you sent the request, e.g., 'Post', 'Email', 'In Person'. Leave empty if not applicable.
_comment_primaryImage: Path to the PPC cancellation image relative to public/. e.g., '/images/ppc/PPC-XXXX/ppc.webp'. Leave empty if no image.
_comment_postcardFrontImage: Path to postcard front image. e.g., '/images/ppc/PPC-XXXX/front.webp'. Leave empty if none.
_comment_postcardBackImage: Path to postcard back image. e.g., '/images/ppc/PPC-XXXX/back.webp'. Leave empty if none.
_comment_description: Detailed description of the PPC, its design, historical context, etc.
_comment_notes: Personal collection notes, condition remarks, etc.
